sub-lethal treatment of A. fumi gatus spores with formalin prolongs the period during which they are non-infective.

A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

sub-lethal treatment of A. fumi-gatus spores with formalin can be employed to produce a suspension of spores which will germinate more slowly than untreated spores, and that this effect is of value in the study of spore germination and the pathogenesis of A. fumingatus infections.

formalin is not a reliable sterilizing agent for spores of A. f umigatus and other filamentous fungi.
